description:
Use this when the user wants to change their public RipClip page: "update my bio", "add my YouTube link to
        my profile", "put this clip on my page", "pin my favourite clips". Anyone can see the page, so confirm the
        words with the user first. Only what is passed changes. bio: up to 200 characters; it replaces the old one.
        links: the whole list, replacing the old one (up to 8; each has a label of up to 40 characters and a full
        https url). auto_posted: whether clips RipClip posts in public are added by themselves. pinned_clip_ids:
        clip_id values from list_clips to show on the page (up to 20; ones already there stay). A pinned clip is a
        public copy. Removing a clip is done in RipClip.
        Not for: a clip's own title or captions (edit_clip). Free: no Horizon Units. Next: get_public_profile.
name: update_public_profile
title: Update my public profile
